scope: bounded descriptive scalar cache analysis; zero model/GPU/remote calls and no repeated full scoring or history audit
counterfactual_definition: product of the relative delta/span marginals of saved triangular J at identical checkpoint; not Fsep factor deletion, W=0, localA deletion or a separately trained control
rank_definition: one plus the count strictly greater; returned rank only if focus belongs to that cohort; no threshold is fitted
fixed_mass_bound_scope: For a fixed state distribution with unchanged mass and remaining atoms, replacing output assignments of m mass within [0,1] changes its mean by at most m, or100m%FS. Invalid and outside masks are disjoint in the frozen reader. This bound does not cover moving state probability mass, changing learned evidence, coordinates, association or normalization.
facts_and_limits: Saved relative-J product substantially helps3172 but is not Fsep; current scalars do not identify a P-B factor cause.
Low invalid/outside mass can exclude direct reassignment of those fixed subsets as a sufficient explanation, but cannot exclude earlier evidence or geometry errors.
Scalar reference entropy/max do not show whether reference peaks are in the correct locations.
State L1 measures distributional dependence; neither a large value nor a saved product improvement establishes incorrect association.
The v6 PMF teacher interventions apply only to v6 frozen weights. v7 uses exact triangular dependence; old independent-P/B diagnostic equations are not valid for v7.
missing_action_changing_information: Exact same-weight full versus Fsep and W=0 readings, preserving their distinct definitions.
Actual star-A versus true triangle-A and per-reference exact-triangle conditional readings, rather than entropy alone.
P-B factor and joint-role conditional evidence at fixed role hypotheses; no independent P/B factor replacement shortcut.
Coordinate-resampling effects evaluated under the complete triangle distribution, with exact native replay before any new diagnosis.
